title: AFTER the flood: Recover
learningObjectives: PLACEHOLDER: Check for hazards before cleaning up.
PLACEHOLDER: Clean safely with boots and gloves, help neighbors, report damage.

intro.situation: Morning. The water has gone down around Jabili, but mud and debris are everywhere.
intro.goal: Check for hazards, put on boots and gloves, clean up, help your neighbor and report the damage.

hazards.name: Dirty flood water
hazards.feedback: Flood water can carry germs that cause sickness, like leptospirosis. Avoid wading in it.
hazards.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

hazards.name: Fallen power line
hazards.feedback: Never touch fallen wires. Keep away and report them.
hazards.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

tasks.name: Boots and gloves
tasks.feedback: Boots and gloves protect you from germs and sharp debris.
tasks.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

tasks.name: Clean the mud
tasks.needsFeedback: Put on boots and gloves first! The relief tent has some.
tasks.feedback: Clean, then disinfect anything the flood water touched.
tasks.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

tasks.name: Bag the debris
tasks.needsFeedback: Put on boots and gloves first! The relief tent has some.
tasks.feedback: Bag debris so no one steps on sharp things.
tasks.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

neighbor.name: Lola Nena
neighbor.ask: Child, could you help me carry my things to the relief tent?
neighbor.thanks: Salamat! Checking on neighbors, especially the elderly, matters.

official.name: Barangay official
official.early: Clean up and help your neighbor first, then report to me.

questions.objective: PLACEHOLDER: Look for hazards before you go back in.
questions.speaker: player
questions.situation: You see a fallen wire and a dirty puddle by the road. What do you do?

choices.text: Walk through the puddle to save time.
choices.feedback: Flood water may be dirty and hide sharp things. Go around.

choices.text: Stay away from both and tell the barangay official.
choices.feedback: Correct! Keep away from hazards and report them.

questions.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

questions.objective: PLACEHOLDER: Report damage to the barangay.
questions.speaker: official
questions.situation: What should you report to the barangay?

choices.text: Damage, hazards like fallen wires, and people who need help.
choices.feedback: Correct! Reports help the barangay send help where it is needed.

choices.text: Nothing. They will find out by themselves.
choices.feedback: Your report helps them act faster. Always report damage and hazards.

questions.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

takeaways: PLACEHOLDER: Check for hazards before cleaning up.
PLACEHOLDER: Wear boots and gloves; avoid flood water.
PLACEHOLDER: Help neighbors and report damage to the barangay.
